title: C¹ radial cut-off with |Dζ| ≤ 3/r (cut-off of Simon 5.2.1)
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, every ξ ∈ ℝ^P and every r > 0 there is ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ of class C¹ such that 0 ≤ ζ(x) ≤ 1 for all x, ζ(x) = 1 for every x in the closed ball B̄_{r/2}(ξ), tsupport ζ (the closure of {ζ ≠ 0}) is contained in the closed ball B̄_r(ξ), and the operator norm of the Fréchet derivative satisfies ‖Dζ(x)‖ ≤ 3/r for every x ∈ ℝ^P (Lean: ‖fderiv ℝ ζ x‖ ≤ 3 / r; ℝ^P = Euclid P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ξ : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ (r / 2), ζ x = 1) ∧ tsupport ζ ⊆ closedBall ξ r ∧ ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ x‖ ≤ 3 / r
